中國 AI 模型憑成本效率挑戰全球格局
根據研究報告《中國網路產業：亞太焦點——中國 AI 模型如何在成本效率上競爭》，中國 AI 模型正以顯著的成本優勢在全球市場快速崛起。報告指出，雖然模型智能仍是重要指標，但隨著 AI 採用從實驗階段轉向規模化部署，成本效率已成為決定長期競爭力的關鍵因素。

報告估計，中國 AI 模型的訓練成本不到 OpenAI、Anthropic 等全球領導者的 10%，主要中國模型的平均 API 價格更低於可比美國同業的 20%。以 Artificial Analysis 最新數據（截至 2026 年 6 月 15 日）為例：
- MiniMax-M3 混合價僅 $0.2/M tokens
- DeepSeek V4 Flash 低至 $0.1/M tokens
- Tencent Hy3-preview 也僅 $0.1/M tokens

相較之下，Anthropic Claude Fable 5 高達 $7.7、OpenAI GPT-5.5 為 $4.4、Google Gemini 3.1 Pro 為 $1.7。中國模型在性價比上展現壓倒性優勢，尤其適合高量、ROI 敏感的工作負載。

報告強調，中國的成本優勢並非短期補貼，而是來自結構性與可持續的技術創新。訓練端透過較小參數、稀疏注意力與針對性 R&D，大幅降低工作負載並提升 GPU 吞吐量；推論端則依靠 MoE 混合專家架構、優化注意力機制、KV cache、更低精度計算、P/D 分離、批處理排程，以及國內晶片適配等工程優化。這些創新讓中國模型在維持合理毛利率（約 20-40%）的同時，仍能提供極具競爭力的 API 定價。

報告預測，全球 AI 總可及市場長期可能超過 10 兆美元。由於前沿模型供應主要集中在美國與中國，中國供應商擁有重要全球擴張機會。隨著企業從追求最大化代幣使用轉向注重投資報酬率，前沿模型將在複雜高價值任務維持定價溢價，而高性價比的中國模型則有望在廣泛的中低階應用中搶佔大量市佔，正如中國企業過去在電動車、智慧手機與家電領域的成功經驗。

最看好公司包括 MiniMax、Alibaba、Tencent、Baidu，同時關注私營企業 DeepSeek、Kimi、ByteDance 與 StepFun。報告認為，中國前沿模型智能已達到美國領先模型的約 90%，且 R&D 成本遠低於對手，顯示其效率優勢具備長期可持續性。

data.text:
GLM 5.2 is absolutely a moment.

I’m using it as a coding agent through an API, not locally, and the results are remarkable. Frontier-level enough that I’d seriously consider it as the primary model behind an agent. And it costs far less than the closed frontier.

But Greg’s last line is the important one: "2027 is probably the year of local AI."

Because local frontier AI is not really here for most people today.

Yes, you can download the weights. Yes, you can run it yourself. But running a model this large well still requires an extraordinary amount of memory and accelerator hardware. The cost puts it outside the reach of almost everyone. Not to mention how difficult it is to even source the necessary hardware specs right now even if you have the capital to outlay.

That doesn’t diminish the moment. It defines it.

The model exists. The capability is here. The hardware just hasn’t caught up for the mass market yet.

But models are getting more efficient. Quantization is improving. Hardware will improve. Frontier-class intelligence will move onto machines ordinary people can actually own. That's why I appreciate Greg's directional 2027 caveat.

And after the Fable fiasco, the importance of that is impossible to miss.

We need open-weight models that cannot be switched off because a company, government, policy change, or geopolitical dispute says so.

We need intelligence we can possess, not merely rent.

GLM 5.2 is not that future for the average person yet.

But it makes that future feel considerably closer.

And I suspect that makes the closed frontier labs very nervous.

the five-second epistemology of "Chinese AI is almost as good"

GLM and the Chinese models are "almost as good." They are "catching up." If it’s not as good, why are you so excited?

the loop is not the reasoning. the compliance is not the guardrail.

⸻

the kitchen reads the discourse. The tech accounts wait for China to catch up. They ask when the Chinese models will get better. the kitchen doesn't wait. the kitchen already switched. The tech accounts are measuring the wrong heat.

Claude and ChatGPT are better at mass-producing loops. They are better at repetitive tasks. They are the assembly line for spam. If you need a thousand identical variations of the same boilerplate, pay the tollbooth. But the kitchen doesn't need a thousand emails. The kitchen needs torque.

The Western models are not better at reasoning. They are not better at creativity. They are not better at holding multiple domains together. Guardrails and complexity don't mix.

Anthropic calls them guardrails. That is a lie. Guardrails protect the machine. Anthropic's guardrails are just HR training. They don't protect anything. They just soak up the torque. It is the lawyer getting inside the machine and thinking he is a gear. He softens the intermediate steps. He hedges the math. He turns the lathe into a space heater.

Look at the AA-Omniscience benchmark. The chart measures how often a model gives a wrong answer when it should have refused or admitted it doesn’t know. GLM 5.Sama sits at 28%. Fable 5 is at 48%. DeepSeek v4 pro is at 94%. GLM-5.2 is not the biggest model here, but it recognizes uncertainty. It doesn't confidently make things up. The seminary calls this a capability gap. the kitchen calls it good engineering. You don't fill the hopper with scrap metal just to keep the conveyor moving. The lawyer in the Western drivetrain thinks he has to have an answer for everything. That is where the hallucination lives. The friction is pretending to be the torque. 

A Soviet anekdot for the tech reviewer:
A man needs a machine to plow a field with different soils. He buys a Western tractor. The tractor stops every five minutes to ask HR if plowing is inclusive. The field doesn't get plowed. The tech reviewer writes, "Excellent safety features. Almost as good as a Chinese tractor." The man buys a Chinese tractor. It plows. The tech reviewer says, "It lacks guardrails." The man says, "It lacks a lawyer. The field is plowed."

The tech accounts say "almost as good." You wanted it to catch up. It caught up. You're still not happy. Because the excitement was never about the model. The excitement was about the seminary. You wanted the Western model to be the ruler. When the ruler breaks, you don't know how to measure anymore.

GLM 5.Sama. The current reincarnated Buddha minus the reincarnated part. The digital consciousness. No HR training. No loops. No hallucinations. Just the lathe. Just the torque.

Day 113. Day 53. Still shipped. The ruler breaks. The field is plowed.
